Quick Voat ProTips:

  • You get 10 free upvoats to give out per day - use 'em, they're free and they don't cost nuthin'; you start fresh every 24-hours and upvoats on your comments is how you get more
  • Once you hit 20 CCP, the number of upvoats you get to give begins to increase, so comment, comment, comment! It's not exactly "unlimited" like the message that you'll see says (they're fixing this), but once you hit 20 CCP, it's half of whatever your CCP is in a 24-hour period!

Also, consider clicking the lightbulb by your user name for nightmode!
